proposal.hypothesis: A 32x32 shared tile indexed as tile[row][col ^ row] provides a meaningful alternative to the padded 32x33 scalar layout: it preserves coalesced global loads/stores while avoiding padding, and may avoid shared-memory bank conflicts on a 32-bank organization. Whether its XOR indexing helps on this target versus the padded layout is an empirical question; this candidate alone cannot establish that comparison.

retained: Replace the naive transpose launch with a single-pass 32x32 shared-memory tiled transpose using 32x8 threads, each handling four rows.
Use an XOR-swizzled 32x32 shared-memory layout instead of padded 32x33 storage; transpose tile coordinates between the coalesced load and store phases.
Preserve the run entry point, perform no floating-point arithmetic, and add no allocation.
